caption:
Body in worship, mind on everything else? Form and heart had split clean apart. (Amos 8:5 devotional)

God isn't after the form you keep, but the heart that keeps wandering off. Even when your heart keeps wandering, He draws it home.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Where do I keep the form of faith while my heart is somewhere else?
